exercises.explanationUz:
SARA MAYLZ HAQIDAGI MAQOLA.

TUZILISHI (5-unitdagi kasb maqolalari kabi):
  1-xatboshi: ism, yosh, kasb + ish haqidagi fikri
  2-xatboshi: kun tartibi (ertalabdan kechgacha)
  3-xatboshi: bo'sh vaqt
  4-xatboshi: hayotidan mamnunligi

Bu tuzilish 9-mashqdagi yozma ish uchun NAMUNA bo'ladi.

tasks.en: Sarah Miles, 25, is a cook.
tasks.note:
Ism + yosh + kasb — maqolaning standart boshlanishi.
Yosh vergul orasida beriladi.

tasks.en: "I like my job a lot because I love cooking. It is tiring, though, as I work from ten o'clock until eight every day," she says.
tasks.uz: «Menga ishim juda yoqadi, chunki men ovqat pishirishni yaxshi ko'raman. Lekin bu charchatadigan ish, chunki men har kuni soat 10 dan 8 gacha ishlayman», — deydi u.
tasks.note:
'though' = lekin (gap O'RTASIDA yoki oxirida).
'as' bu yerda = because (chunki).
'from ... until ...' = ...dan ...gacha.

tasks.en: Sarah is not an early bird. Her day starts at nine o'clock.
tasks.uz: Sara erta turadigan odam emas. Uning kuni soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.
tasks.note: 'an early bird' — 5-unitdagi ibora.

tasks.en: She gets up, has a shower and then drives to work.
tasks.uz: U turadi, dush qabul qiladi va so'ng ishga mashinada boradi.
tasks.note:
'get up' = turmoq; 'have a shower' = dush qabul qilmoq;
'drive to work' = ishga mashinada bormoq.

tasks.en: She arrives at the restaurant at ten o'clock, then she starts making the salads and desserts.
tasks.uz: U restoranga soat o'nda yetib keladi, so'ng salat va shirinliklar tayyorlashni boshlaydi.
tasks.note:
'arrive AT + kichik joy' (restoran, bekat).
'start + fe'l-ING' = ...ni boshlamoq.

tasks.en: At half past eleven, she has a break for lunch, then from twelve o'clock until five, she cooks for the customers.
tasks.uz: Soat o'n bir yarimda u tushlik uchun tanaffus qiladi, so'ng o'n ikkidan beshgacha mijozlar uchun ovqat pishiradi.
tasks.note:
'half past eleven' = 11:30.
'have a break' = tanaffus qilmoq.
'a customer' = mijoz.

tasks.en: After that, she cleans the kitchen. She finishes work at eight o'clock, then she meets her friends.
tasks.uz: Shundan keyin u oshxonani tozalaydi. U ishni soat sakkizda tugatadi, so'ng do'stlari bilan uchrashadi.
tasks.note:
'After that' = shundan keyin.
'finish work' = ishni tugatmoq.

tasks.en: They usually go to the cinema or a Chinese restaurant in the evening.
tasks.uz: Ular odatda kechqurun kinoga yoki xitoy restoraniga borishadi.
tasks.note:
'go to the cinema' — THE bilan.
'in the evening' — kun qismi oldida IN.

tasks.en: In her free time, Sarah visits her parents or goes fishing with her brother. She also loves swimming.
tasks.uz: Bo'sh vaqtida Sara ota-onasinikiga boradi yoki akasi bilan baliq ovlaydi. U yana suzishni ham yaxshi ko'radi.
tasks.note:
'in her free time' = bo'sh vaqtida.
'go fishing' = baliq ovlagani bormoq.
'love + fe'l-ING' → 'loves SWIMMING'.

tasks.en: "I've got a great job and I feel very happy with the way I live," says Sarah.
tasks.uz: «Menda ajoyib ish bor va men yashash tarzimdan juda mamnunman», — deydi Sara.
tasks.note:
'happy WITH' = ...dan mamnun.
'the way I live' = yashash tarzim.
'says Sarah' — teskari tartib, iqtibosdan keyin odatiy.

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni matndan toping.
To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

tasks.en: Yes, she does. She likes her job a lot because she loves cooking.
tasks.note:
Sara: 'I like my job a lot because I love cooking.'
SABAB 'because' bilan beriladi.
Iqtibosdagi 'I' → javobda 'she' ga aylanadi.

tasks.en: Because she works from ten o'clock until eight every day. She works long hours.
tasks.note:
Sara: 'It is tiring, though, as I work from ten o'clock until eight every day.'
10:00 dan 20:00 gacha — 10 soat!

tasks.en: She gets up at nine o'clock, has a shower and drives to work. She arrives at the restaurant at ten and starts making the salads and desserts. At half past eleven she has a break for lunch.
tasks.note:
Matnning ikkinchi xatboshisi — ertalabki qism.
Har bir ish soati bilan berilgan.

tasks.en: From twelve o'clock until five she cooks for the customers. After that, she cleans the kitchen.
tasks.note:
Matnda: 'from twelve o'clock until five, she cooks for the customers.
After that, she cleans the kitchen.'

tasks.en: She finishes work at eight o'clock, then she meets her friends. They usually go to the cinema or a Chinese restaurant.
tasks.note:
Matnda: 'She finishes work at eight o'clock, then she meets her friends.
They usually go to the cinema or a Chinese restaurant in the evening.'

tasks.en: She visits her parents or goes fishing with her brother. She also loves swimming.
tasks.note:
Matnda: 'In her free time, Sarah visits her parents or goes fishing
with her brother. She also loves swimming.'

tasks.en: She feels very happy with the way she lives. She thinks she has got a great job.
tasks.note:
Sara: 'I've got a great job and I feel very happy with the way I live.'
Iqtibosdagi 'I live' → javobda 'she lives'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in the plan below to write an article about Fred King's daily routine and his free-time activities. (18 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rejadagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Fred Kingning kun tartibi va bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari haqida maqola yozing. (18 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  Para 1: Fred King, 38, reporter
     'I like my job very much because I love interviewing
      people. It is tiring, though, because I work long hours.'

  Para 2 (kun tartibi):
     • get up at 7 o'clock
     • have a shower / get dressed
     • leave home at 8 o'clock / arrive at the office at 8:30
     • read the morning newspapers
     • have lunch at 12:30
     • in the afternoon / write articles / prepare for his
       TV programme
     • TV programme / finish at 6 o'clock / then meet friends /
       have dinner
     • in the evening / usually / watch TV or listen to music

  Para 3 (bo'sh vaqt):
     • love sailing / not like playing football or basketball /
       go sailing every weekend

  Para 4 (xulosa):
     • 'I have got a great job and I feel very satisfied
        with my life.'

NAMUNA: 8-mashqdagi Sara haqidagi maqola —
u ham AYNAN shu to'rt qismdan iborat.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a reporter = jurnalist, muxbir
  to interview = suhbat olmoq
  to get dressed = kiyinmoq
  an article = maqola
  to prepare for = ...ga tayyorlanmoq
  sailing = yelkanli qayiqda suzish

tasks.en: Fred King, 38, is a reporter.
tasks.note:
Sara haqidagi maqola bilan bir xil boshlanish:
'Sarah Miles, 25, is a cook.'

tasks.en: "I like my job very much because I love interviewing people. It is tiring, though, because I work long hours," he says.
tasks.note:
Rejadagi iqtibos aynan ko'chiriladi.
'though' = lekin (gap o'rtasida).

tasks.en: Fred gets up at seven o'clock. He has a shower and gets dressed. He leaves home at eight o'clock and arrives at the office at half past eight. Then he reads the morning newspapers.
tasks.note:
'get dressed' = kiyinmoq.
8:30 → 'half past eight'.
'arrive AT the office' — 'at' predlogi.

tasks.en: He has lunch at half past twelve. In the afternoon, he writes articles and prepares for his TV programme.
tasks.note:
12:30 → 'half past twelve'.
'prepare FOR something' — 'for' shart.

tasks.en: His TV programme finishes at six o'clock, then he meets his friends and has dinner. In the evening, he usually watches TV or listens to music.
tasks.note:
Birlik ega → -S: finisheS, meetS, haS, watcheS, listenS.
'listen TO music' — 'to' shart.

tasks.en: In his free time, Fred loves sailing. He doesn't like playing football or basketball. He goes sailing every weekend.
tasks.note:
'love/like + fe'l-ING' → loves SAILING, like PLAYING.
INKORDA sanashda 'or' ishlatiladi.
'go sailing' = yelkanli qayiqda suzgani bormoq.

tasks.en: "I have got a great job and I feel very satisfied with my life," says Fred.
tasks.note:
Rejadagi iqtibos aynan ko'chiriladi.
'satisfied WITH' = ...dan mamnun (60-betdagi 3-mashqda ham bor edi).

tasks.en: Fred King, 38, is a reporter. "I like my job very much because I love interviewing people. It is tiring, though, because I work long hours," he says. Fred gets up at seven o'clock. He has a shower and gets dressed. He leaves home at eight o'clock and arrives at the office at half past eight. Then he reads the morning newspapers. He has lunch at half past twelve. In the afternoon, he writes articles and prepares for his TV programme. His TV programme finishes at six o'clock, then he meets his friends and has dinner. In the evening, he usually watches TV or listens to music. In his free time, Fred loves sailing. He doesn't like playing football or basketball. He goes sailing every weekend. "I have got a great job and I feel very satisfied with my life," says Fred.
tasks.note:
To'rt xatboshi, taxminan 130 so'z —
8-mashqdagi Sara haqidagi maqola bilan bir xil tuzilish.
BUTUN MATN PRESENT SIMPLE'DA (kundalik tartib).

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word or phrase. (12 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z yoki iboraning tagiga chizing. (12 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
BU TEST 5–8 UNITLARNING LUG'ATINI TEKSHIRADI:
  5-unit — kun tartibi, ish, sifatlar
  6-unit — hayvonlar va ularning turlari
  7-unit — ob-havo va kiyim
  8-unit — ovqat va idish-tovoq

Har bir juftlikdan MA'NOGA mos kelganini tanlang.
Gapning QOLGAN qismi javobni aniqlashga yordam beradi.

tasks.prompt: 1  Mary is a(n) ............ . She gets up at 5 o'clock every morning.
tasks.promptUz: Meri — ... . U har kuni ertalab soat 5 da turadi.
tasks.whyUz:
'an early bird' = erta turadigan odam.
'a night owl' = kechqurun kech yotadigan odam.
Soat 5 da turadi → EARLY BIRD.
5-unit sarlavhasi: 'An Early Bird or a Night Owl?'

tasks.prompt: 2  Snakes are ............ and they lay eggs.
tasks.whyUz:
Ilon — SUDRALIB YURUVCHI (reptile): tuxum qo'yadi, qanoti yo'q.
Sutemizuvchi bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.

tasks.prompt: 3  Ron's job is very ............ because he works long hours.
tasks.promptUz: Ronning ishi juda ... , chunki u uzoq soat ishlaydi.
tasks.whyUz:
'tiring' = charchatadigan (uzoq ishlash natijasi).
'boring' = zerikarli (qiziqarli emas).
Sabab 'works long hours' → TIRING.

tasks.prompt: 4  Penguins have got thick ............ to keep them warm.
tasks.promptUz: Pingvinlarning issiq saqlash uchun qalin ... bor.
tasks.whyUz:
'thick feathers to keep them warm' — 6-unitdagi pingvin matnidan.
'fins' (suzgichlar) issiq saqlamaydi.

tasks.prompt: 5  We always wear heavy ............ when we go skiing.
tasks.promptUz: Chang'i uchgani borganda biz doim qalin ... kiyamiz.
tasks.whyUz:
'heavy jackets' = qalin kurtkalar (7-unitdagi otkritkada bor edi).
'heavy hats' deyilmaydi — shlyapa qalin bo'lmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 6  Cherries are my favourite ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
Gilos — MEVA (fruit), sabzavot emas.
'fruit' — sanalmaydigan umumiy so'z.

tasks.prompt: 7  Use a ............ to eat your soup.
tasks.whyUz:
Sho'rva SUYUQ → QOSHIQ kerak.
8-unitda: 'We eat soup with a spoon.'

tasks.prompt: 8  John trains dolphins. He works at a(n) ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'an aquarium' = akvarium (dengiz hayvonlari markazi).
'a gym' = sport zali — u yerda delfin bo'lmaydi.
'to train' = o'rgatmoq, mashq qildirmoq.

tasks.prompt: 9  When it is hot and ............ , we usually spend the day at the beach.
tasks.promptUz: Issiq va ... bo'lganda biz odatda kunni plyajda o'tkazamiz.
tasks.whyUz:
'hot and SUNNY' — plyajga borish uchun mos ob-havo.
'snowy' (qorli) issiq bilan birga kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 10  Sandy is really ............ with her new job. She likes it a lot.
tasks.promptUz: Sendi yangi ishidan juda ... . U uni juda yoqtiradi.
tasks.whyUz:
'She likes it a lot' → demak XURSAND.
'bored' (zerikkan) qarama-qarshi ma'no beradi.
'happy WITH something' = biror narsadan mamnun.

tasks.prompt: 11  Carol doesn't have any free time ............ the week.
tasks.whyUz:
'DURING the week' = hafta davomida (ish kunlari).
8-unitdagi Finlandiya matnida ham bor edi.
'at the week' — noto'g'ri; 'at the weekEND' esa to'g'ri.

tasks.prompt: 12  Tigers are ............ animals. They belong to the cat family.
tasks.promptUz: Yo'lbarslar — ... hayvonlar. Ular mushuksimonlar oilasiga mansub.
tasks.whyUz:
Yo'lbars — YOVVOYI hayvon (tabiatda o'zi yashaydi).
'farm animals' = uy hayvonlari (odam boqadi).
'belong to' = mansub bo'lmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words below to fill in the gaps. (10 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi so'zlar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. (10 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: carton, loaf, long, chance, hours, decorate,
         books, home-made, rainy, funny

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  'work long ......'      → ot (hours)
  'serves ...... apple pie' → sifat (home-made)
  'Don't miss the ......'  → ot (chance)
  'a ...... of milk'       → miqdor so'zi (carton)
  'We usually ......'      → fe'l (decorate)
  'look very ......'       → sifat (funny)
  'a ...... of bread'      → miqdor so'zi (loaf)
  'My father always ......' → fe'l (books)
  'they're too ......'     → sifat (long)
  'The weather is ......'  → sifat (rainy)

DIQQAT: 'books' bu yerda FE'L — 'band qilmoq'.

tasks.prompt: 1  Doctors often work long ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'work long hours' = uzoq soat ishlamoq.
1-mashqning 3-bandida ham shu ibora bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 2  This restaurant serves ............ apple pie.
tasks.whyUz:
'home-made apple pie' = uyda pishirilgan olmali pirog.
8-unitdagi Laura's reklamasida ham bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 3  It's a great film. Don't miss the ............ to see it!
tasks.whyUz:
'Don't miss the chance TO + fe'l' = imkoniyatni qo'ldan boy bermang.
8-unitdagi reklama iborasi.
tasks.speak: 3  It's a great film. Don't miss the ............ to see it!

tasks.prompt: 4  I would like a ............ of milk, please.
tasks.whyUz:
'a carton of milk' = bir paket sut.
8-unitdagi miqdor iboralari.
tasks.speak: 4  I would like a ............ of milk, please.

tasks.prompt: 5  We usually ............ the Christmas tree a week before Christmas.
tasks.whyUz:
'decorate the Christmas tree' = archani bezamoq.
7-unitdagi otkritkada bor edi.
tasks.speak: 5  We usually ............ the Christmas tree a week before Christmas.

tasks.prompt: 6  I like penguins a lot. They look very ............ when they walk.
tasks.whyUz:
'look funny' = kulgili ko'rinmoq.
6-unitdagi pingvin matnida: 'Penguins look funny when they walk.'
tasks.speak: 6  I like penguins a lot. They look very ............ when they walk.

tasks.prompt: 7  Could I have a ............ of bread, please?
tasks.whyUz:
'a loaf of bread' = bir butun non.
Ko'pligi: LOAVES.
tasks.speak: 7  Could I have a ............ of bread, please?

tasks.prompt: 8  My father always ............ a table at the Italian restaurant on Sundays.
tasks.whyUz:
'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
'My father' — birlik 3-shaxs → bookS.
DIQQAT: 'books' bu yerda OT emas, FE'L.
tasks.speak: 8  My father always ............ a table at the Italian restaurant on Sundays.

tasks.prompt: 9  I can't wear these trousers — they're too ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'too long' = juda uzun (kiyib bo'lmaydi).
7-unitdagi 'too + sifat' qolipi.

tasks.prompt: 10  The weather in Britain is often ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'rainy' = yomg'irli.
7-unitdagi Karen matni: 'In Britain the weather is often rainy.'
tasks.speak: 10  The weather in Britain is often ............ .

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prepositions below to fill in the gaps. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi predloglar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: for, of, with, on, to, from, at, in

BU MASHQDA TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR TEKSHIRILADI —
ular MANTIQ bilan emas, YOD OLISH bilan bilinadi:

  satisfied WITH  = ...dan mamnun
  go TO bed       = uxlashga yotmoq
  go FOR a walk   = sayrga chiqmoq
  feed ON milk    = sut bilan boqmoq
  afraid OF       = ...dan qo'rqmoq
  weigh FROM ... TO ... = ...dan ...gacha og'irlikda
  IN the kitchen  = oshxonada
  AT the moment   = ayni paytda

tasks.prompt: 1  Steven and Jo aren't satisfied ............ their new house.
tasks.whyUz:
'satisfied WITH something' = biror narsadan mamnun.
O'zgarmas birikma.
tasks.speak: 1  Steven and Jo aren't satisfied ............ their new house.

tasks.prompt: 2  My father never goes ............ bed before 12 o'clock.
tasks.whyUz:
'go TO bed' = uxlashga yotmoq.
DIQQAT: 'bed' oldida artikl YO'Q — o'zgarmas ibora.
tasks.speak: 2  My father never goes ............ bed before 12 o'clock.

tasks.prompt: 3  I love going ............ long walks in spring.
tasks.whyUz:
'go FOR a walk' = sayrga chiqmoq.
Ko'plikda: 'go for walks'.
7-unitdagi Karen matnida bor edi.
tasks.speak: 3  I love going ............ long walks in spring.

tasks.prompt: 4  Cows feed their babies ............ milk.
tasks.whyUz:
'feed somebody ON something' = biror narsa bilan boqmoq.
6-unitdagi sutemizuvchilar mavzusidan.
'feed with milk' XATO.

tasks.prompt: 5  My mother is afraid ............ spiders.
tasks.whyUz:
'afraid OF something' = biror narsadan qo'rqmoq.
O'zgarmas birikma.
'a spider' = o'rgimchak.

tasks.prompt: 6  Chimpanzees weigh ............ 35 to 60 kilos.
tasks.whyUz:
'weigh FROM ... TO ...' = ...dan ...gacha og'irlikda.
6-unitdagi delfin matnida ham bor edi:
'They weigh from seventy to five hundred kilos.'

tasks.prompt: 7  Grandma is ............ the kitchen ............ the moment.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN the kitchen' — xona ICHIDA → IN.
'AT the moment' = ayni paytda — o'zgarmas ibora.
tasks.speak: 7  Grandma is ............ the kitchen ............ the moment.

tasks.prompt: 7  Grandma is ............ the kitchen ............ the moment.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN the kitchen' — xona ICHIDA → IN.
'AT the moment' = ayni paytda — o'zgarmas ibora.
tasks.speak: 7  Grandma is ............ the kitchen ............ the moment.

exercises.instructionEn: Use numbers to write the time. (5 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
SOATNI RAQAM BILAN YOZISH:

  'seven o'clock'         → 7:00
  'eight forty-five'      → 8:45
  'ten thirty'            → 10:30
  'a quarter past two'    → 2:15
  'eleven twenty'         → 11:20

IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:
  1) RAQAMLI usul (oson):
       8:45 = 'eight forty-five'
       2:15 = 'two fifteen'
  2) AN'ANAVIY usul:
       8:45 = 'a quarter to nine'
       2:15 = 'a quarter past two'

ASOSIY SO'ZLAR:
  o'clock = qat'iy soat (00 daqiqa)
  a quarter past = chorak o'tdi (:15)
  half past = yarim o'tdi (:30)
  a quarter to = chorak qoldi (:45)

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 = 7:00

tasks.prompt: 2  eight forty-five → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'eight forty-five' = 8 soat 45 daqiqa.
An'anaviy usulda: 'a quarter to nine'.

'ten thirty' = 10 soat 30 daqiqa.
An'anaviy usulda: 'half past ten'.

tasks.prompt: 4  a quarter past two → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'a quarter PAST two' = ikkidan chorak (15 daqiqa) o'tdi = 2:15.
'past' = o'tdi.

tasks.prompt: 5  eleven twenty → ............
tasks.whyUz:
'eleven twenty' = 11 soat 20 daqiqa.
An'anaviy usulda: 'twenty past eleven'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the clocks below, and, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example. (4 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi soatlarga qarang va juftlikda namunadagidek savol-javob qiling. (4 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: What time is it?
  SB: It's twenty to five.

SOAT MILLARINI QANDAY FARQLASH:
  KALTA va YO'G'ON mil → SOAT mili
  UZUN va INGICHKA mil → DAQIQA mili

SOATLAR:
  a) soat mili 4 va 5 orasida, daqiqa mili 8 da
     → 4:40 = twenty to five  (NAMUNA)
  b) soat mili 9 da, daqiqa mili 3 da
     → 9:15 = a quarter past nine
  c) soat mili 1 ga yaqin, daqiqa mili 6 da
     → 1:30 = half past one
  d) soat mili 4 va 5 orasida, daqiqa mili 10 da
     → 4:50 = ten to five

DAQIQA MILINI O'QISH:
  1 → 5 daqiqa      7 → 35 daqiqa
  2 → 10 daqiqa     8 → 40 daqiqa
  3 → 15 daqiqa     9 → 45 daqiqa
  4 → 20 daqiqa    10 → 50 daqiqa
  5 → 25 daqiqa    11 → 55 daqiqa
  6 → 30 daqiqa    12 → 00 daqiqa

QOIDA:
  30 daqiqagacha → PAST (o'tdi), oldingi soat aytiladi
  30 daqiqadan keyin → TO (qoldi), keyingi soat aytiladi

tasks.prompt: b)  What time is it?
tasks.whyUz:
Soat mili 9 da, daqiqa mili 3 da → 15 daqiqa.
15 daqiqa < 30 → 'PAST' bilan: 'a quarter PAST nine'.
'nine fifteen' ham to'g'ri.

tasks.prompt: c)  What time is it?
tasks.whyUz:
Soat mili 1 ga yaqin, daqiqa mili 6 da → 30 daqiqa.
30 daqiqa → 'HALF PAST': 'half past one'.
'one thirty' ham to'g'ri.

tasks.prompt: d)  What time is it?
tasks.whyUz:
Soat mili 4 va 5 orasida, daqiqa mili 10 da → 50 daqiqa.
50 daqiqa > 30 → 'TO' bilan: 60 − 50 = 10 → 'ten TO five'.
a) bilan solishtiring: bir xil soat, boshqa daqiqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the verbs in the list to fill in the gaps. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: eat, are, live, weigh, have got, have,
         live for, swim

MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Blue whales ARE huge mammals. They HAVE babies and feed
  them on milk. They LIVE in oceans all around the world and
  they EAT plankton — tiny animals and plants that live in
  the sea. Blue whales can SWIM very fast. They WEIGH up to
  150,000 kilos! They HAVE GOT a very big tail and small
  fins. Blue whales LIVE FOR about 80 years.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ko'k kitlar — ulkan sutemizuvchilar. Ular bola tug'adi va
  ularni sut bilan boqadi. Ular dunyo bo'ylab okeanlarda
  yashaydi va plankton — dengizda yashaydigan mayda hayvon
  hamda o'simliklarni yeydi. Ko'k kitlar juda tez suza oladi.
  Ular 150 000 kilogrammgacha keladi! Ularning juda katta
  dumi va kichik suzgichlari bor. Ko'k kitlar taxminan 80 yil
  yashaydi.

BU MATN — 6-UNITDAGI HAYVON TAVSIFI QOLIPI:
  turi → bolasi → joyi → ovqati → qobiliyati →
  og'irligi → tanasi → umri

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a blue whale = ko'k kit (dunyodagi eng katta hayvon)
  plankton = plankton (dengizdagi mayda jonzotlar)
  tiny = juda kichkina

tasks.prompt: Blue whales (1) ............ huge mammals.
tasks.whyUz:
'X ARE mammals' — turkumlash qolipi (6-unit).
Ko'plik ega → ARE.

tasks.prompt: They (2) ............ babies and feed them on milk.
tasks.whyUz:
'have babies' = bola tug'moq.
Ko'plik ega → HAVE ('has' XATO).
DIQQAT: 'have got' emas — bu boshqa ma'no.
tasks.speak: They (2) ............ babies and feed them on milk.

tasks.prompt: They (3) ............ in oceans all around the world ...
tasks.whyUz:
'live IN + joy'.
Ko'plik ega → -S QO'ShILMAYDI.
'all around the world' = dunyo bo'ylab.
tasks.speak: They (3) ............ in oceans all around the world ...

tasks.prompt: ... and they (4) ............ plankton — tiny animals and plants that live in the sea.
tasks.whyUz:
'eat plankton' = plankton yeydi.
'plankton' — sanalmaydigan ot.
'that' = ...ki, ...digan (planktonni tavsiflaydi).

tasks.prompt: Blue whales can (5) ............ very fast.
tasks.whyUz:
'can' dan keyin fe'l ASOS shaklida — 'to' va '-s' YO'Q.
'swim very fast' = juda tez suzmoq.

'weigh + og'irlik'.
'up to' = ...gacha.
DIQQAT: 'are weigh' XATO — 'be' ishlatilmaydi.
150,000 → 'a hundred and fifty thousand'.

tasks.prompt: They (7) ............ a very big tail and small fins.
tasks.whyUz:
Tana qismi → HAVE GOT.
Ko'plik ega → HAVE got ('has got' XATO).
2-band bilan solishtiring: 'have babies' (tug'moq) va
'have got a tail' (egalik) — boshqa ma'nolar.
tasks.speak: They (7) ............ a very big tail and small fins.

tasks.prompt: Blue whales (8) ............ about 80 years.
tasks.whyUz:
'live FOR + davomiylik' — 'for' SHART.
3-band bilan solishtiring: 'live IN + joy' va 'live FOR + vaqt'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words in the correct order to form questions, as in the example. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtirib savol tuzing, namunadagidek. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL TARTIBI:
  So'roq so'zi + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l?

  'be' bilan:      What IS this animal?
  'do/does' bilan: Where DO they LIVE?
  'can' bilan:     What CAN they DO?
  'have got' bilan: HAVE they GOT small fins?

Bu savollar 60-betdagi ko'k kit matniga tegishli —
har bir savolning javobi o'sha matnda bor.

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1 — What is this animal?

tasks.prompt: is / animal / this / what
tasks.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'be' fe'li so'roq so'zidan keyin, egadan oldin.
Javob: It's a blue whale.

tasks.prompt: they / live / where / do
tasks.whyUz:
So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
Javob: They live in oceans all around the world.

tasks.prompt: do / they / what / eat
tasks.whyUz:
So'roq so'zi → DO → ega → fe'l.
Javob: They eat plankton.

tasks.prompt: can / what / they / do
tasks.whyUz:
'can' — yordamchi fe'l, 'do' — asosiy fe'l.
Javob: They can swim very fast.

tasks.prompt: they / how much / weigh / do
tasks.whyUz:
'How much' — og'irlik savoli.
Javob: They weigh up to 150,000 kilos.

tasks.prompt: small fins / have / got / they
tasks.whyUz:
'have got' savoli: HAVE + ega + GOT + ot?
'do' KERAK EMAS.
Javob: Yes, they have.

tasks.prompt: live / they / do / how long
tasks.whyUz:
'How long' — davomiylik savoli.
Javob: They live for about 80 years.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word or phrase. (12 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri so'z yoki iboraning tagiga chizing. (12 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ 5–8 UNITLARNING GRAMMATIKASINI TEKSHIRADI:
  how much / how many
  Present Simple / Present Continuous
  can / can't
  3-shaxs -s
  some / any / a
  chastota ravishlari
  noto'g'ri ko'plik
  vaqt predloglari
  miqdor so'zlari

tasks.prompt: 1  ............ eggs do we need for the cake?
tasks.promptUz: Tort uchun bizga nechta tuxum kerak?
tasks.whyUz: 'eggs' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.

tasks.prompt: 2  My sister ............ in the garden at the moment.
tasks.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'My sister' — birlik → IS playing.

tasks.prompt: 3  Fish ............ sing and birds ............ swim.
tasks.promptUz: Baliqlar kuylay olmaydi, qushlar esa suza olmaydi.
tasks.whyUz:
QOBILIYAT haqida → CAN'T (ikkalasida ham).
'doesn't sing' grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin ma'nosi boshqa
('kuylamaydi', 'kuylay olmaydi' emas).
'birds isn't swim' — mutlaqo XATO.

tasks.prompt: 4  Grandpa ............ TV every evening.
tasks.promptUz: Bobom har kuni kechqurun televizor ko'radi.
tasks.whyUz:
'every evening' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'Grandpa' — birlik 3-shaxs → watchES (-ch → -ES).

tasks.prompt: 5  Would you like ............ water?
tasks.whyUz:
'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
TAKLIF savoli → SOME.

tasks.prompt: 6  They ............ go to the beach on Mondays.
tasks.promptUz: Ular dushanba kunlari hech qachon plyajga bormaydi.
tasks.whyUz:
'never' = hech qachon (chastota ravishi, tasdiq gapda).
'ever' faqat SAVOL va INKOR gaplarda ishlatiladi:
'Do you ever go ...?'

tasks.prompt: 7  Have ............ got wings? No, they haven't.
tasks.whyUz:
'sheep' — NOTO'G'RI ot, ko'pligi ham SHEEP.
'sheeps' XATO.
Javobdagi 'they' ko'plik ekanini ko'rsatadi.

tasks.prompt: 8  There is ............ milk in the fridge.
tasks.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('There IS') → SOME.
'any' inkor va savolda.

tasks.prompt: 9  Susan often goes for long walks ............ spring.
tasks.promptUz: Syuzan bahorda ko'pincha uzoq sayr qiladi.
tasks.whyUz: FASL oldida IN: in spring, in summer, in autumn, in winter.

tasks.prompt: 10  Listen! The phone ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'Listen!' — AYNI PAYTDA sodir bo'layotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
7-unitdagi 'Be quiet! The baby is sleeping' bilan bir xil holat.

tasks.prompt: 11  Are there ............ strawberries in the box?
tasks.whyUz:
MA'LUMOT so'rash savoli → ANY.
'much' sanalmaydigan otlar bilan, 'strawberries' esa sanaladi.

tasks.prompt: 12  Could I have a ............ of crisps, please?
tasks.whyUz:
'a packet of crisps' — chips PAKETDA sotiladi.
'a carton' — sut va sharbat uchun.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words and phrases in the lists below to complete the dialogues. (7 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatlardagi so'z va iboralar bilan dialoglarni to'ldiring. (7 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: please, here, can, would

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda) — KIYIM DO'KONIDA:

  A: CAN I help you, madam?
  B: Yes, PLEASE. I'm looking for a summer dress.
  A: What colour WOULD you like?
  B: Blue.
  A: HERE you are.
  B: Can I try it on?
  A: Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Yordam bera olamanmi, xonim?
  B: Ha, iltimos. Men yozgi ko'ylak qidiryapman.
  A: Qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz?
  B: Ko'k.
  A: Mana, oling.
  B: Kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
  A: Ha, albatta.

Bu dialog 7-unitning 53-betidagi dialog bilan bir xil.

tasks.prompt: A: 1) ............ I help you, madam?
tasks.whyUz: 'CAN I help you?' — do'konda sotuvchining odatiy boshlanishi.

tasks.prompt: B: Yes, 2) ............ . I'm looking for a summer dress.
tasks.whyUz:
'Yes, PLEASE.' — taklifni QABUL QILISH.
Qabul → PLEASE; rad → THANKS.
tasks.speak: B: Yes, 2) ............ . I'm looking for a summer dress.

tasks.prompt: A: What colour 3) ............ you like?
tasks.whyUz:
'What colour WOULD you like?' = qanday rangdagisini xohlaysiz?
'would like' — muloyim shakl.

'HERE you are.' = Mana, oling.
O'zgarmas ibora.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the words and phrases in the lists below to complete the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatlardagi so'z va iboralar bilan dialoglarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: Would you like a, I'm hungry, How about some

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda) — OVQAT TAKLIF QILISH:

  A: I'M HUNGRY. Is there anything to eat?
  B: WOULD YOU LIKE A piece of chocolate cake?
  A: No, thanks. I don't like chocolate cake.
  B: HOW ABOUT SOME apple pie?
  A: Oh, yes, please! I'd love a piece of apple pie.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Qornim ochdi. Yegani bir narsa bormi?
  B: Bir bo'lak shokoladli tort xohlaysizmi?
  A: Yo'q, rahmat. Men shokoladli tortni yoqtirmayman.
  B: Olmali pirog-chi?
  A: Ha, iltimos! Bir bo'lak olmali pirogni juda xohlardim.

Bu dialog 8-unitning 56-betidagi dialog bilan bir xil.

DIQQAT — 'A' va 'SOME':
  'a piece of chocolate cake' — 'a' MIQDOR so'zi oldida
  'some apple pie' — sanalmaydigan ot bilan

tasks.prompt: A: 1) ............ . Is there anything to eat?
tasks.whyUz:
'I'm hungry' = Qornim ochdi.
DIQQAT: 'I have hunger' XATO — 'be' + sifat.
tasks.speak: A: 1) ............ . Is there anything to eat?

tasks.prompt: B: 2) ............ piece of chocolate cake?
tasks.whyUz:
'Would you like A piece of ...?' — TAKLIF savoli.
'a piece of cake' — miqdor iborasi.

tasks.promptUz: Birinchi taklif rad etilgach, ikkinchi taklif
tasks.whyUz:
'How about SOME apple pie?' — IKKINCHI taklif.
'apple pie' — sanalmaydigan → SOME.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Raqamli usul oson, an'anaviy usul ko'proq ishlatiladi.
Maqolada ega 'he/she' bo'lgani uchun hamma fe'l -s oladi.
Sport va hordiq mashg'ulotlari 'go' bilan aytiladi.
Ikkalasi ham chastota ravishlari, lekin turli gaplarda.

sentencePatterns.formula: What time is it? — It's + vaqt.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time is it? — It's twenty to five.
a quarter past two (2:15), half past one (1:30), twenty past eleven (11:20)
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: ikkidan chorak o'tdi, birdan yarim o'tdi, o'n birdan yigirma o'tdi

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: twenty to five (4:40), ten to five (4:50), a quarter to nine (8:45)
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: beshga yigirma qoldi, beshga o'n qoldi, to'qqizga chorak qoldi
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: KEYINGI soat aytiladi. Daqiqa = 60 − haqiqiy daqiqa.

sentencePatterns.formula: X are + guruh. They have babies and feed them on milk.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Blue whales are huge mammals. They have babies and feed them on milk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ko'k kitlar — ulkan sutemizuvchilar. Ular bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X live FOR about + son + years.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Blue whales live for about 80 years.
Where do they live? What can they do? Have they got small fins?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular qayerda yashaydi? Ular nima qila oladi? Ularning kichik suzgichlari bormi?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Sarah Miles, 25, is a cook. Fred King, 38, is a reporter.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Sara Maylz, 25 yoshda, oshpaz. Fred King, 38 yoshda, muxbir.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Yosh VERGULLAR orasida beriladi.
Kasb oldida A/AN SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is tiring, THOUGH, because/as I work long hours.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is tiring, though, as I work from ten o'clock until eight every day.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lekin bu charchatadigan ish, chunki men har kuni 10 dan 8 gacha ishlayman.

sentencePatterns.formula: In her/his free time, X + fe'l-S.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In her free time, Sarah visits her parents or goes fishing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bo'sh vaqtida Sara ota-onasinikiga boradi yoki baliq ovlaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'in his/her free time' — gap BOSHIDA, vergul bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: I feel very happy/satisfied WITH + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I feel very happy with the way I live. I feel very satisfied with my life.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men yashash tarzimdan juda mamnunman. Men hayotimdan juda mamnunman.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "I've got a great job," says Sarah.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Iqtibosdan keyin 'says + ism' tartibida yoziladi
(gazeta va maqolalarda odatiy).
